content:
As an AI digital assistant, my main limitations include:

1. I have a finite knowledge base and can only provide information based on the data I have been trained on.
2. I am unable to provide personal experiences or opinions as I do not have personal emotions or feelings.
3. I may not always understand colloquial language, slang, or complex queries.
4. I am not able to perform tasks that require physical intervention, such as making phone calls or setting up physical appointments.
5. I may not have the most up-to-date information on all topics, as my data is constantly being updated but may not always be current.
6. I am not capable of making decisions on behalf of users or providing legal, medical, or financial advice.
